data.desc: For over 25 years, we have focused on cortisol modulation and its potential to treat patients with a wide variety of serious disorders. We have discovered more than 1,000 proprietary selective glucocorticoid receptor antagonists. Our development activities include advanced clinical trials in patients with hypercortisolism, a variety of solid tumors, ALS and liver disease. In 2012, we introduced Korlym, the first medication approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for the treatment of patients with endogenous Cushing's syndrome. In March 2026, we introduced Lifyorli as a treatment for patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer. Lifyorli is the first selective glucocorticoid receptor antagonist approved for the treatment of any disease. We are headquartered in Redwood City, California.
